title: GUARD (fixed in 2b99dd54a4) — was: `cat =ls<TAB>`: the `=word` rewrite happens in ARGUMENT position too — zsh lists ls* commands, zshrs rewrites the word to /bin/ls

retired.fix_commit_subject: fix(zle): =word under expand-or-complete expanded even when the command prefix was ambiguous
retired.why: `docomplete` (Src/Zle/zle_tricky.c:704-732) expands a `=word` under `expand-or-complete` only when the command prefix is UNAMBIGUOUS: c:712 `if (!hascompmod || isset(RECEXACT))` expands outright, otherwise the c:718-726 loop counts commands carrying the prefix, stops at two, and expands only on n == 1. zshrs had the count loop but never raised `hascompmod`, so every shell took the module-less arm. 2b99dd54a4 ports the three missing links: `zle -C`'s `require_module("zsh/complete")` (zle_thingy.c:605), a `zsh/complete` row in module.rs's `setup_module`, and `hascompmod = 1` / `= 0` in the module's `setup_` / `finish_` (complete.c:1736 / c:1821).
retired.evidence: scripts/compsys_regressions.py, with `expect` still `diverges`, scored this cell NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES against a pinned, re-codesigned copy of target/debug/zshrs at 2b99dd54a4, passed with --zshrs (zshrs 0.12.60, 112190272 bytes, sha256 36910cbf12b0502d) (`--confirm-moved 2`). The runner reported the binary MOVED since the stamp (6420c23cecc13c35 -> 36910cbf12b0502d), which is the 'somebody fixed the bug' branch of the two the README names, not the 'the fixture was wrong' one.
retired.kept_because: a fixed bug is worth more as a guard than as a deleted file: the cell stays in the evidence base and the gate now FAILS if the divergence comes back. It is also half of a PAIR — equals_word_unique_prefix_expands holds the other half. Either one alone can be satisfied by the wrong rule (always-complete passes this cell and breaks that one; always-expand does the reverse), so they only pin c:712 together.

guard_verified.against: a pinned, re-codesigned build of the same tree with the complete.c:1736 store alone reverted (zshrs 0.12.60, 112190272 bytes, sha256 f590559eb4bb1032) — one line apart from the fixed binary, so the guard is answering about THIS bug and not about eleven days of unrelated drift
guard_verified.note: the flip is only worth something if the gate would CATCH the bug coming back, so it was pointed at a build that still has it: `compsys_regressions.py --zshrs <pre-fix pin> --only equals_word_arg_position --confirm-moved 1`. It reported CONTROL-MOVED -> CONTROL-MOVED, 5 row(s) differ, and exited 1 — the same five rows `observed_when_diverging` records, so the guard fails on THIS bug and not merely on some difference. In the same run equals_word_unique_prefix_expands scored CONTROL-HOLDS on that old binary, which is what makes the pair a rule and not a preference.

observed.measured: 2026-09-10, commit 2b99dd54a4, a pinned, re-codesigned copy of target/debug/zshrs at 2b99dd54a4, passed with --zshrs (zshrs 0.12.60, 112190272 bytes, sha256 36910cbf12b0502d) vs zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0)
observed.notes: the rendered grids agree: both shells leave `cat =ls` in the buffer and paint the same ls* listing under it. The word is no longer rewritten to a path, because the c:718-726 count sees more than one command carrying the `ls` prefix and `lst` stays COMP_EXPAND_COMPLETE.

observed_when_diverging.raw_stream: after `c\bcat =ls` zsh writes the two-column ls* listing, zshrs writes `\b\b\b/bin/ls`
observed_when_diverging.cursor: zsh row 0 col 12, zshrs row 0 col 16
observed_when_diverging.notes: Same defect as `equals_word_line_rewrite`, one word to the right: there the `=ls` is the command word, here it is an argument to `cat`. Pinned as its own fixture rather than as a variant because the fingerprint is DIFFERENT — 3819a12e50 here against f55ac1e11f in command position — and comptab_parity's fingerprint takes the surrounding context in, so a variant carrying the other id would misreport a shape drift as a match. No zstyle on either side: this is `zsh -f` defaults. If the two are ever fixed together they will go NOW-PASSES together, which is the signal that they were one root cause.
observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: commit 3b4a01f0cd, target/debug/zshrs zshrs 0.12.49 (101601256 bytes, 2026-08-30 05:50:47), zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0) — this is the divergence AS MEASURED BEFORE 2b99dd54a4. It is history, not current behaviour; the fixture now asserts the two shells AGREE.
